acceptance.item: P4-RT-04-03: Opening a valid link rewrites the address bar with replaceState before the reader acts (T10, T11, and T1, T4, T5, T6, T15, T16)
acceptance.test: site/tests/e2e/history-no-write-on-load.spec.ts > the address bar is not rewritten on load > <route>: no replaceState or pushState before the reader acts (10 routes); site/tests/unit/history.test.ts > a link applied after registration > nothing is written on load when a tool applies its link after registering / after the reader acts, only the instances the reader has changed are written
acceptance.evidence: Severity minor (no adjustment). Red on the base build: 10 failed, the same rewrites the verifier saw (for example /tools/mirror/?g=B2 rewritten to ?z=1&g=B2&c=n&s=1,1&w= at 1056 ms; M7 ?b1.r=0.1 rewritten to ?b1.z=1&b1.g=A2&b1.r=0.1&b1.j=coxeter&b1.e=p at 1689 ms). Unit: 3 failed | 10 passed with the base history.ts. Green: e2e 10 passed plus a new check that a reader's click then writes ?z=1&g=A3&v=p&m=f&c=p&s=1,0,0&w=1.2; unit 13 passed. Cause: ToolFrame registers an instance before its tool applies the link (child effects run first; T10 a task after hydration), so the link's state reached stateChanged as a reader change. Fix in site/src/lib/history.ts only: an instance whose keys are in the bar at registration is opened from a link; until the reader acts inside its frame (pointerdown, keydown, click, input or change reaching its [data-frame] root, or exampleLoaded), its changes, and those of instances the reader has not acted on while such a link waits (linkTo followers), are recorded and not written; a write encodes only instances the reader changed and keeps the others' keys as the bar holds them. No tool, ToolFrame or exported signature changed. Commit 91c3fae.

acceptance.item: P4-RT-07-03: KaTeX fonts (font-display: block, not preloaded) arrive after the first paint: a lesson reloaded mid-page shifts by CLS 0.30 to 0.33, and the whole-document relayout adds about 40 percent of M7's TBT
acceptance.test: site/tests/e2e/katex-font-preload.spec.ts > M7: every KaTeX font the page fetches is preloaded from its head, and every preload is used; site/tests/unit/katex-font-preloads.test.ts > KaTeX font preloads > a page preloads exactly the fonts its KaTeX markup uses
acceptance.evidence: Severity major (TBT half; the CLS half was refuted by the verifier). Red on the base build: 'font preloads in the head of M7' expected > 0, received 0 (M0 the same). Green: 2 passed; unit 5 passed. Cause: the fonts were discovered only at the first layout and arrived after the first paint, relaying out the whole lesson. Fix: lib/katex.ts reads which font each KaTeX class selects from the installed katex.min.css; site/src/middleware.ts (build time) adds one <link rel=preload as=font type=font/woff2 crossorigin> per font the page's KaTeX markup uses, before the KaTeX stylesheet, with import.meta.env.BASE_URL and the katex/<version>/fonts/ path; pages without KaTeX unchanged. M7 gets exactly the lens's three (Main-Regular, Math-Italic, SansSerif-Regular). npm run lab, alternated at load 2.7 to 4.3: M7 TBT base 318.9 and 341.1 ms, fixed 146.9 and 162.8 ms (limit 200); /tools/board/ (no KaTeX) 209.9 and 188.7 vs 165.7 and 312.8 (noise). Lens font-swap script on the fixed build: CLS 0.0000 in all 8 runs (base 0.30 to 0.33). Commit 4f473a7; P3-X1's no-preload record changed in the fragment, with the reason.

acceptance.item: P4-RT-08-04: Attack 28, sibling of P3-RT-08-10: the credits page omits clsx (MIT), which the Svelte runtime bundles into the client chunk of every island
acceptance.test: site/tests/e2e/credits-bundled.spec.ts > bundled libraries on the credits page > clsx code is in a client chunk, so the credits page must list clsx and its licence; ... > every package whose code the build ships has a row on the credits page, with its licence; site/tests/unit/dependencies-bundled.test.ts > a bundled package that no package.json names gets a row with its licence
acceptance.evidence: Severity major (no adjustment). Red on the base build: 2 failed | 2 passed ('credits page lists clsx, shipped in client.sNPtvj1U.js'; tr[data-package=clsx] count 0). Green: 4 passed; unit 31 passed (dependencies-recorded and dependencies-shipped still pass). Cause: dependencies.ts built the table from the three package.json files only. Fix: an Astro integration (lib/pages/shippedPackages.ts, registered in astro.config.mjs) records, from the client build's and the worker bundles' emitted chunks, the package of every module with code in them; the credits page of the same build (same process) adds a row with version, licence and author for each package no package.json names. This build: clsx 2.1.1 MIT, rolldown 1.2.13 MIT (runtime helpers), vite 8.3.4 MIT (preload helper); the page now says 8 packages reach the reader. A production build fails without the list. A build with a credits page writes the list per output directory for the browser test; unit-suite fixture builds write none. The adopted reproducer reads site/dist, so it lives in the browser suite (CI runs unit tests before the build), as RT-FIX-P3-perf-b did. Commits 7262096, ec2c060.

deviations.why: CI runs npm run check (the unit suite) before npm run build, so a unit test reading site/dist would fail on every fresh checkout; precedent RT-FIX-P3-perf-b (registry-outs.spec.ts). Assertions unchanged.

openQuestions: site/tests/unit/links-internal.test.ts > 'npm run build runs the check after every build' times out at 5000 ms in a full site-unit run on this loaded machine (load 10 to 17); alone it passes in 3.2 to 4.0 s. Measured alone at load 11: base config 3446 and 3468 ms, this branch 3626 and 4044 ms. A plain Node import of astro.config.mjs: median 1815 ms (base) vs 1879 ms (this branch), within the spread 1428 to 2088. The new shippedPackages.ts import costs at most tens of ms per spawn; the test's default 5000 ms timeout is the margin GATE may want to look at.

site/tests/e2e/T10.spec.ts > 'no long task on E8 loads and the graph switch' fails 1 of 3 runs at load about 11 on both the base build (66 ms task) and this branch (52 ms task): machine-bound, not caused here.

toolframe-hydration.spec.ts and T07 'T1 colour-class panel' failed once inside long Playwright batches with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading Symbol(filename))' (the Vite SSR cache issue the round notes name) and passed alone.

With links on a lesson page, a linkTo follower that changes only because its leader's link was applied is not written until the reader acts; afterwards followers are written as before. A touch that scrolls over a tool whose link is still being applied asynchronously (T10 facts in tasks, T11 long replay) counts as the reader acting, and that link is then written normalised (recorded in the fragment).
handoff: Files outside the cluster area: t10/config.ts and t11/config.ts change by one re-export line each (the T10 fixer edits other parts of t10/; the hunk is only the T10_BOARDS block), plus new t10/boards.ts, t11/boards.ts, site/src/middleware.ts and one integration in site/astro.config.mjs. T10 and T11 need no local change for P4-RT-04-03: history.ts alone now holds a link's state back until the reader acts in the frame, so ToolFrame was not touched. The proposed fix for P4-RT-04-03 (register with the link's state as initial, or a new history.ts call from tools) was not followed, because it would need edits to ToolFrame, T10 and T11 (other fixers' files) and would miss linkTo followers. The lens should rerun RT-04 attack 21 on all routes (including M6 and M1 followers), RT-07 attack 19 (npm run lab on M6 and M7) and RT-08 attack 28 against a fresh build. No finding is needs-decision.
